evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate), an explicit presentation/access tag (current/completed_record) and an origin/status entry co-occur for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple labeled content entries identify items and attributes (color) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Explicit origin/status fields (completed_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, copied_prior_record) separate content identity from its status/source.

O.rationale: The report states display layout and marks items as 'current' with origin metadata describing representation/access.
